scene.label: Act 2, Scene 7
scene.title: SCENE VII. Belmont. A room in Portia's house.
scene.location: Belmont. A room in Portia's house.

content.text: Flourish of cornets. Enter Portia with the Prince of Morocco and both their trains.

lines.text: Go, draw aside the curtains and discover
lines.plainText: Go draw aside the curtains and discover

lines.text: The several caskets to this noble prince.
lines.plainText: The several caskets to this noble prince

lines.text: Now make your choice.
lines.plainText: Now make your choice

lines.text: The first, of gold, who this inscription bears,
lines.plainText: The first of gold who this inscription bears

lines.text: "Who chooseth me shall gain what many men desire."
lines.plainText: Who chooseth me shall gain what many men desire

lines.text: The second, silver, which this promise carries,
lines.plainText: The second silver which this promise carries

lines.text: "Who chooseth me shall get as much as he deserves."
lines.plainText: Who chooseth me shall get as much as he deserves

lines.text: This third, dull lead, with warning all as blunt,
lines.plainText: This third dull lead with warning all as blunt

lines.text: "Who chooseth me must give and hazard all he hath."
lines.plainText: Who chooseth me must give and hazard all he hath

lines.text: How shall I know if I do choose the right?
lines.plainText: How shall I know if I do choose the right

lines.text: The one of them contains my picture, prince.
lines.plainText: The one of them contains my picture prince

lines.text: If you choose that, then I am yours withal.
lines.plainText: If you choose that then I am yours withal

lines.text: Some god direct my judgment! Let me see.
lines.plainText: Some god direct my judgment Let me see

lines.text: I will survey the inscriptions back again.
lines.plainText: I will survey the inscriptions back again

lines.text: What says this leaden casket?
lines.plainText: What says this leaden casket

lines.text: "Who chooseth me must give and hazard all he hath."
lines.plainText: Who chooseth me must give and hazard all he hath

lines.text: Must give, for what? For lead? Hazard for lead!
lines.plainText: Must give for what For lead Hazard for lead

lines.text: This casket threatens; men that hazard all
lines.plainText: This casket threatens men that hazard all

lines.text: Do it in hope of fair advantages:
lines.plainText: Do it in hope of fair advantages

lines.text: A golden mind stoops not to shows of dross,
lines.plainText: A golden mind stoops not to shows of dross

lines.text: I'll then nor give nor hazard aught for lead.
lines.plainText: I'll then nor give nor hazard aught for lead

lines.text: What says the silver with her virgin hue?
lines.plainText: What says the silver with her virgin hue

lines.text: "Who chooseth me shall get as much as he deserves."
lines.plainText: Who chooseth me shall get as much as he deserves

lines.text: As much as he deserves! Pause there, Morocco,
lines.plainText: As much as he deserves Pause there Morocco

lines.text: And weigh thy value with an even hand.
lines.plainText: And weigh thy value with an even hand

lines.text: If thou be'st rated by thy estimation
lines.plainText: If thou be'st rated by thy estimation

lines.text: Thou dost deserve enough, and yet enough
lines.plainText: Thou dost deserve enough and yet enough

lines.text: May not extend so far as to the lady.
lines.plainText: May not extend so far as to the lady

lines.text: And yet to be afeard of my deserving
lines.plainText: And yet to be afeard of my deserving

lines.text: Were but a weak disabling of myself.
lines.plainText: Were but a weak disabling of myself

lines.text: As much as I deserve! Why, that's the lady:
lines.plainText: As much as I deserve Why that's the lady

lines.text: I do in birth deserve her, and in fortunes,
lines.plainText: I do in birth deserve her and in fortunes

lines.text: In graces, and in qualities of breeding;
lines.plainText: In graces and in qualities of breeding

lines.text: But more than these, in love I do deserve.
lines.plainText: But more than these in love I do deserve

lines.text: What if I stray'd no farther, but chose here?
lines.plainText: What if I stray'd no farther but chose here

lines.text: Let's see once more this saying grav'd in gold:
lines.plainText: Let's see once more this saying grav'd in gold

lines.text: "Who chooseth me shall gain what many men desire."
lines.plainText: Who chooseth me shall gain what many men desire

lines.text: Why, that's the lady, all the world desires her.
lines.plainText: Why that's the lady all the world desires her

lines.text: From the four corners of the earth they come
lines.plainText: From the four corners of the earth they come

lines.text: To kiss this shrine, this mortal breathing saint.
lines.plainText: To kiss this shrine this mortal breathing saint

lines.text: The Hyrcanian deserts and the vasty wilds
lines.plainText: The Hyrcanian deserts and the vasty wilds

lines.text: Of wide Arabia are as throughfares now
lines.plainText: Of wide Arabia are as throughfares now

lines.text: For princes to come view fair Portia.
lines.plainText: For princes to come view fair Portia

lines.text: The watery kingdom, whose ambitious head
lines.plainText: The watery kingdom whose ambitious head

lines.text: Spets in the face of heaven, is no bar
lines.plainText: Spets in the face of heaven is no bar

lines.text: To stop the foreign spirits, but they come
lines.plainText: To stop the foreign spirits but they come

lines.text: As o'er a brook to see fair Portia.
lines.plainText: As o'er a brook to see fair Portia

lines.text: One of these three contains her heavenly picture.
lines.plainText: One of these three contains her heavenly picture

lines.text: Is't like that lead contains her? 'Twere damnation
lines.plainText: Is't like that lead contains her 'Twere damnation

lines.text: To think so base a thought. It were too gross
lines.plainText: To think so base a thought It were too gross

lines.text: To rib her cerecloth in the obscure grave.
lines.plainText: To rib her cerecloth in the obscure grave

lines.text: Or shall I think in silver she's immur'd
lines.plainText: Or shall I think in silver she's immur'd

lines.text: Being ten times undervalued to tried gold?
lines.plainText: Being ten times undervalued to tried gold

lines.text: O sinful thought! Never so rich a gem
lines.plainText: O sinful thought Never so rich a gem

lines.text: Was set in worse than gold. They have in England
lines.plainText: Was set in worse than gold They have in England

lines.text: A coin that bears the figure of an angel
lines.plainText: A coin that bears the figure of an angel

lines.text: Stamped in gold; but that's insculp'd upon;
lines.plainText: Stamped in gold but that's insculp'd upon

lines.text: But here an angel in a golden bed
lines.plainText: But here an angel in a golden bed

lines.text: Lies all within. Deliver me the key.
lines.plainText: Lies all within Deliver me the key

lines.text: Here do I choose, and thrive I as I may.
lines.plainText: Here do I choose and thrive I as I may

lines.text: There, take it, prince, and if my form lie there,
lines.plainText: There take it prince and if my form lie there

lines.text: Then I am yours.
lines.plainText: Then I am yours

lines.text: O hell! what have we here?
lines.plainText: O hell what have we here

lines.text: A carrion Death, within whose empty eye
lines.plainText: A carrion Death within whose empty eye

lines.text: There is a written scroll. I'll read the writing.
lines.plainText: There is a written scroll I'll read the writing

content.text: [Exit with his train. Flourish of cornets.]

lines.text: A gentle riddance. Draw the curtains, go.
lines.plainText: A gentle riddance Draw the curtains go

lines.text: Let all of his complexion choose me so.
lines.plainText: Let all of his complexion choose me so
